جَيَّارٌ Quick lime, and the mixtures thereof, with which are plastered watering-troughs or tanks, and baths; syn. صَارُوجٌ: (S, K:) quick lime and gypsum mixed with ashes: (IAar TA:) or quick lime alone. (TA. [See also جِيرٌ.]) ＝
-A2- [A limeburner: so in the present day: see أَتُونٌ.] ＝
-A3- Heat in the chest, by reason of rage or hunger; as also ↓ جَائِرٌ : (S, K:) or cough, or the like. (Ham p. 56.) It is app. of the measure فَعَّالٌ; or it may be of the measure فَيْعَالٌ; or فَوْعَالٌ [originally جَوْيَارٌ]. (IJ, TA.) ―
-b2- Strength, or vehemence. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
